references.text: Another event where Jesus heals a blind and mute man possessed by demons, demonstrating Jesus' power over demons and his ability to perform miracles.
Here Jesus heals a man who was deaf and had a speech impediment, showing parallels in Jesus' healings of those affected by physical and possibly spiritual afflictions.
Jesus heals a demon-possessed man who was mute, and after the healing the man could speak. This again demonstrates Jesus' authority over demons and his ability to restore normal function.
